answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 7772 Country: India Title: What is your opinion with regarding creating a symbol (round) like black at forehead dor doing Sajda? Question: Assalamuwalikum What is your opinion with regarding creating a symbol (round) like black at forehead dor doing Sajda? Answer ID: 7772 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1616/1533=D/1429) If the impression was naturally created due to excessive sajdah (prostration), then it will be a cause of reward, in-sha-Allah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
